title: Single Cell High-Throughput qRT-PCR Protocol
author: Sirisha Achanta
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-919/v1
materials: STEP 3: Reverse Transcription : Note: This step is performed on ice Add 1.8 μl of 5X VILO Reaction Mix ( Component of Superscript VILO cDNA synthesis kit ) to each sample (unknown sample, positive control and negative control). Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and proceed to Thermocycler Thermocycler : VILO activation Add 1.5 μl of RT mix to each sample ( reagent preparation ) Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and proceed to Thermocycler Thermocycler : RT Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and place on ice Note: This is an optional stopping point. Samples can be stored overnight at 4⁰C or stored at -20⁰C for a year.

STEP 4: Pre-amplification : Note: This step is performed on ice Add 11.6 μl of PreAmp Mix ( reagent preparation ) to each sample Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and proceed to Thermocycler Thermocycler : PreAmp22 Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and place on ice Note: This is an optional stopping point. Samples can be stored overnight at 4⁰C. Note: We consider 22 cycles of pre-amp optimal for single cells collected using LCM. We do not recommended to pre-amplification of samples over 22 cycles due to observed increase in production of non-specific PCR fragments and primer-dimers.

STEP 5: Exonuclease treatment : Add 8 μl of Exonuclease Mix ( reagent preparation ) to each sample Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and proceed to Thermocycler Thermocycler : Exonuclease Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and place on ice Add 54 μl of TE buffer to each sample Note: This is an optional stopping point. Samples can be stored overnight at 4⁰C or stored at -20⁰C for a year.
1.3 PROCEDURE FOR RUNNING A BIOMARK CHIP:

STEP 4: Data collection software for BioMark HD System : Double-click the Data Collection Software icon on the desktop to launch the software. Click Start a New Run . Check the status bar to verify that the lamp and the camera are ready. Make sure both are green before proceeding. Remove and discard the blue protective film from the bottom of the chip. Place the chip into the reader. Click Load . Verify chip barcode and chip type. Click Next . Chip Run file: Select New . Browse to a file location for data storage. Click Next . Application, Reference, Probes: Select Application Type-- Gene Expression for version 3.1.2 or higher software (for all earlier versions, contact Fluidigm Technical Support). Select Passive Reference: ROX . Select Probe-- Single probe . Select probe type: EvaGreen . Click Next . Click Browse to find the thermal cycling protocol file. steps.title: Prepare Primer Dilutions
steps.instruction: Order forward and reverse primers at 400µM stock to create a 200µM mix. Prepare additional working dilutions of the forward and reverse primer mix.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 200 µM and 100 µM mixes for Pre-amplification.
Prepare 20 µM mix for BioMark Chip loading.
Prepare 2 µM mix for traditional qPCR.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Mix Lysis enhancer and Resuspension buffer (CellDirect kit) based on sample count.

substeps.instruction: For 1 sample: Mix 0.5 μl Lysis enhancer + 5 μl Resuspension buffer (Total 5.5 μl).
For 96 samples (110 with overage): Mix 55 μl Lysis enhancer + 550 μl Resuspension buffer (Total 605 μl).

steps.title: Prepare RNA Dilution Series
steps.instruction: Create a 2X or 3X RNA dilution series (6-8 points) from whole tissue as a positive control and primer efficiency metric.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the mean sample input corresponds to the middle points of the series.
Example for single cell (approx 10pg RNA) 2X series: 2pg/μl, 4pg/μl, 8pg/μl, 16pg/μl, 32pg/μl, and 64pg/μl.

steps.title: Prepare RT Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the RT Mix immediately prior to use in Step 3.

substeps.instruction: For 1 sample: Mix 0.30 μl 10X Superscript III Mix (VILO kit) + 0.2 μl T4 Gene 32 Protein + 1 μl DNA Suspension Buffer (Total 1.5 μl).
For 96 samples (110 with overage): Mix 33 μl 10X Superscript III Mix (VILO kit) + 22 μl T4 Gene 32 Protein + 110 μl DNA Suspension Buffer (Total 165 μl).

steps.title: Generate 500nM Primer Pool
steps.instruction: Generate a primer pool and store at -20⁰C. Use DNA Suspension Buffer to reach final volume.

substeps.instruction: For 1-200 primers: Use 100 μM primers. Combine 1 μl of each primer; bring total volume to 200 μl with DNA Suspension Buffer (e.g., 96 primers: 96 μl primers + 104 μl buffer).
For 201-400 primers: Use 200 μM primers. Combine 1 μl of each primer; bring total volume to 400 μl with DNA Suspension Buffer (e.g., 300 primers: 300 μl primers + 100 μl buffer).

steps.title: Prepare PreAmp Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the PreAmp Mix immediately prior to use in Step 4.

substeps.instruction: For 1 sample: Mix 10 μl TaqMan PreAmp Master Mix + 1.6 μl 500 nM primer pool (Total 11.6 μl).
For 96 samples (110 with overage): Mix 1100 μl TaqMan PreAmp Master Mix + 176 μl 500 nM primer pool.

steps.title: Prepare Exonuclease Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Exonuclease Mix immediately prior to use in Step 5 to remove unincorporated primers and single stranded cDNA.

substeps.instruction: For 1 sample: Mix 0.8 μl Exonuclease I reaction buffer 10X + 1.6 μl Exonuclease I + 5.6 μl DNA Suspension Buffer (Total 8 μl).
For 96 samples (110 with overage): Mix 88 μl Exonuclease I reaction buffer 10X + 176 μl Exonuclease I + 616 μl DNA Suspension Buffer (Total 880 μl).

steps.title: Perform Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse cells on the LCM cap or in tubes for cell culture samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 5.5 μl lysis buffer to the capture surface on the LCM Cap.
Cover the cap with a 0.2 ml tube, ensuring a tight seal.
Incubate at 75°C on a heat block for 15 minutes.
Cool cap and tube on ice for 5 minutes.
Spin down and transfer cell lysate to a PCR tube or plate.

steps.title: Set Up Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample plate on ice.

substeps.instruction: Unknown samples: Transfer lysed cells from LCM caps to PCR plate. For extracted RNA, transfer 1 μl RNA (10-100pg) and add 4.5 μl lysis buffer.
Positive control: Transfer 1 μl RNA standard and add 4.5 μl lysis buffer.
Negative control: Add 1 μl molecular grade water and 4.5 μl lysis buffer to a single well.

steps.title: Perform Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Execute the following thermal profiles for RT, Pre-amplification, and Exonuclease treatment.

substeps.instruction: VILO activation: 65°C for 1 min 30 sec, then 4°C.
Pre-amp (22 cycles): 95°C (10 min), then 22 cycles of [96°C (5 sec), 60°C (4 min)], then 4°C.
Exonuclease: 37°C (30 min), 80°C (15 min), then 4°C.

steps.title: Optional: Traditional qPCR
steps.instruction: Measure samples using a traditional qPCR instrument with a 20 μl reaction mix.

substeps.instruction: Mix 2 μl Pre-amplified/Exonuclease treated sample + 2 μl Primer pair (2μM) + 10 μl TaqMan Universal PCR Master Mix + 6 μl Molecular grade water.
Run a standard 30-35 cycle PCR.

steps.title: Prepare Chip Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the Chip Sample plate on the day of the run.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Sample Mix: For 1 sample, mix 4 μl 2X SsoFast EvaGreen Supermix with Low ROX + 0.4 μl 20X DNA Binding Dye Sample Loading Reagent. (For 48.48 chip/55 samples: 220 μl Supermix + 22 μl Dye; For 96.96 chip/110 samples: 440 μl Supermix + 44 μl Dye).
Aliquot 4.4 μl Sample mix into wells: A1-H12 for 96.96 IFC; wells 1-6 in each row (A1-A6...H1-H6) for 48.48 IFC.
Add 3.6 μl Exonuclease treated sample to the plate.
Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and place on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Chip Assay Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the assay plate (can be done one day prior and stored at 4°C).

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 4 μl 2X Assay Loading Reagent into 48 or 96 wells based on chip layout.
Add 4 μl of corresponding primer pairs at 20μM concentration.
Spin down for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and place on ice.

steps.title: Prime and Load BioMark Chip
steps.instruction: Prime the chip and load samples and assays using the IFC Controller.

substeps.instruction: Inject control line fluid into each accumulator.
Place chip in IFC Controller (MX for 48.48, HX for 96.96) and run the Prime script (113x for 48.48, 136x for 96.96). Eject chip.

Pipette 5 μL of each assay and 5 μL of each sample into respective inlets. Load column 1 (A1, B1..H1) in alternate wells starting top left; repeat for next 5 columns (96.96) or 2 columns (48.48). For the 7th (96.96) or 4th (48.48) column, start with the second well from the top.
Return chip to controller and run Load Mix script (113x for 48.48, 136x for 96.96).
Remove chip and clean surface debris with scotch tape.
